sloka: ऐणेयम् माम्सम् आहृत्य शालाम् यक्ष्यामहे वयम् ।कर्त्व्यम् वास्तुशमनम् सौमित्रे चिरजीवभिः ॥२-५६-२२॥
transliteration: aiṇeyam māmsam āhṛtya śālām yakṣyāmahe vayam ।kartvyam vāstuśamanam saumitre cirajīvabhiḥ ॥2-56-22॥

translations.english: O Lakshmana those who intend to live for long (in this hut), should pacify the deity presiding over here. Therefore, we shall bring the venison of a black antelope and make necessary offerings.
